description: This file defines data structures, enums, and functions related to ROHC (Robust Header Compression) configuration, including profile types, profile selection, and configuration management, with associated formatters for output.

classes.name: ocudu::rohc::rohc_profile_config
classes.description: Manages the set of enabled ROHC profiles using a bitmap, allowing enabling/disabling profiles and checking their status.

classes.name: ocudu::rohc::rohc_config
classes.description: Holds the overall ROHC configuration including type, maximum CID, profile selection, and continuation flag.

methods.name: to_string(rohc_type_t)
methods.description: Converts a rohc_type_t enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: to_string(rohc_profile)
methods.description: Converts a rohc_profile enum value to its string description.

methods.name: to_number(rohc_profile)
methods.description: Returns the numeric value associated with a rohc_profile enum.
